### `-emithls-add-io-functions`

_Add IO functions for top function._

### `-emithls-fold-expression`

_Fold expression's content, such as `-a > 2`, to `a < 2`_

### `-emithls-fuse-operator`

_Fuse operators i.e. `+=`, `-=`, and `*=`._

### `-emithls-insert-includes`

_Insert include headers based on the content._

### `-emithls-loop-fusion`

_Merge two emithls.for loops if possible and resolve related ops._

### `-emithls-merge-cast-chain`

_Merge a chain of pure cast operations into one._

### `-emithls-pragma-dse`

_Perform a design space exploration on where to put pragmas._

#### Options

```
-available-bram : Total Number of BRAM on the hardware
-available-dsp  : Total Number of DSP on the hardware
```

### `-emithls-pragma-insertion`

### `-emithls-resolve-helpers`
